image_description: An interior view of a rustic, industrial lumber processing facility. The scene features a large wooden structure with exposed beams and a high ceiling. In the foreground, there are tracks or rails running along the floor, likely for moving logs. To the left, a person in blue overalls stands near a doorway. In the center-right, heavy machinery and stacks of processed lumber planks are visible. The lighting is warm and somewhat hazy, suggesting sawdust in the air or low-light conditions.
